## PM triage — `pm:blocked` on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#7167 landing

File collision: `packages/plugin-grid/` is being edited by PR objectui#7167 (objectui#7154) right now. Unblocks automatically.

### Graded `bug`, not `finding` — this is a live user-facing defect

A `dependsOn` lookup column is **permanently uneditable**. The key arrives at `LookupField` (via the schema spread, not the copy set), and the picker gates forever because the grid supplies **none** of `LookupField`'s three dependent-value channels. PR objectui#2216 gave the *form* that injection; the grid never got it.

That is not a cosmetic gap — an author who declares `dependsOn` on a grid-edited lookup gets a control that can never be opened, with no diagnostic.

### How this was found is the point

I fenced objectui#7154 with *"⛔ `dependsOn` — read objectui#2215 FIRST"*, expecting the answer to be a deferral. Reading it turned the deferral into a **finding**: objectui#2215 is closed **COMPLETED**, so "that was already handled" is true of the form and false of the grid. A fence meant to slow a risky key down instead located a defect nobody had attributed.

### ⚠️ The seam decision is genuinely open and must not be pre-made

Saved-row vs staged-row — whether the dependent value comes from the persisted record or the in-flight edit — is a real design question with different behaviour for a user mid-edit. The card spells it out rather than choosing, which is correct.

⛔ Whoever takes this must **not** pick the cheaper channel and present it as the conclusion. If measurement does not settle it, it comes back to the maintainer. (objectui#6889 is this session's reminder that the cheap-looking branch is not reliably the affordable one.)

## Unblocked — PR #7167 landed (`47035ce79`); dispatch-readiness note so the seam does not stall this card

`pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` was applied when #7167 merged (verified in the tree, not by sha: the new `lookupPickerKeys-7154.test.tsx` is present alongside the control `lookupDisplayFieldSpelling-6875.test.tsx`). The file collision is gone.

⛔ **Not dispatched this round — the seat's 3 running dev lanes are full** (#6252, #6771, #7166). This card is **first in line** when one frees: it is the only `bug`-graded live user-facing defect in the queue.

### Sequencing the A/B seam — decidable by measurement, so it need not go back to the maintainer first

My 08:19 triage fenced this: *"whoever takes this must not pick the cheaper channel and present it as the conclusion."* That fence stands, and it does **not** mean the card must wait. What it means is that A can never be *the answer*. Here is the order that respects both:

**Measurement 1, before any code — is B Clause ②-engaged?** B needs `renderCellEditor`'s editor context (`{ column, row, value, stage, commit, cancel }`) to carry the pending record. The question is whether that context type is **published surface** (reachable from `@object-ui/types` / `DataTableSchema`'s declared editor context) or internal to `plugin-grid`.

- **B is NOT Clause ②** ⇒ ⭐ **do B.** It is the card's own recommendation, it matches the form's semantics from PR #2216, and there is then no reason to ship an interim.
- **B IS Clause ②** ⇒ B is unlandable today whatever its merit — the fable `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota is exhausted (it is what holds #6896/PR #7111, #6881/PR #7066, #7087, and steps 2–5 of #6771). ⇒ ship **A as an explicitly-labelled interim**: `dependentValues: ctx.row`, with the staleness written into the code as a comment naming this card and the follow-up, plus a filed card for B. ⛔ **A does not close this card in that branch** — it downgrades a permanently-uneditable field to a field scoped by the saved value, and the card stays open for B.

The asymmetry that makes A acceptable *as an interim only*: a field that can **never be filled** is a hard defect with no workaround; a field scoped by the persisted parent rather than the staged one is wrong only in the narrower case where the parent was edited in the same unsaved session. Strictly better, and strictly not finished.

⚠️ Whichever branch runs, the staleness in A is the **same silent-wrongness class** this seat landed three refusals against this week (#7146 `no-positive-flow`, #7147 `no-positive-magnitude`, #7148 `unsized-rows`). If A ships, the question "should the user be told the scope is from the saved row" is live, not settled — do not let it disappear into a comment.

### Two unmeasured items to carry into the dispatch

- **Incidence is unmeasured**: whether any shipped app declares `dependsOn` on a field that also appears in an editable grid. Reachable by construction from the spec, but no user report is attached and this was a test-environment rendering measurement, not a browser dogfood run. ⛔ Do not let that gap be reported as "no impact."
- **`plugin-detail`'s `InlineFieldInput` renders the same widgets and was NOT measured** — it may carry the identical gap. Worth one probe during the dispatch; if it does, that is a second card, not a widening of this one.

## Claim — `domain:ui` execution seat, R19

- **Session**: `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`

- **Domain**: `ui` · **Grade**: `bug` (kept) · **Worktree**: dedicated, off `origin/main` (`899730e0a` or later)
- **Serial constraints cleared**: `plugin-grid` is momentarily contended — **#7166** is running in the same package. ⚠️ Declared rather than ignored: #7166 touches `relationalMetaKeys.ts` and the `applyRelationalMeta` copy set; this card touches `ObjectGrid.renderCellEditor`'s context construction. Disjoint symbols in the same package. The dispatch order tells this lane to re-derive on whatever head exists at branch time and to expect a merge from `main` before pushing.

The sequencing is already ruled in [comment 5491922231](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7165#issuecomment-5491922231) and is carried into the dispatch order verbatim: **measurement 1 decides A vs B**, and ⛔ **A is never the conclusion**.

Dispatching now because a lane freed (#6252 → PR #7180, #6771 → PR #7184, both reported). This is the only `bug`-graded live user-facing defect in the queue — a `dependsOn` lookup column that can never be opened, with no diagnostic.

## Interim landed in PR #7193 — ⛔ **this card stays OPEN.** Measurement 1: **B IS Clause ②-engaged.**

The A/B sequencing I ruled at dispatch resolved to the A branch, and every condition attached to it is met.

### Why B is unavailable today — three independent Clause ② surfaces

| surface | evidence |
|---|---|
| the declared type | `DataTableSchema.renderCellEditor` in `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` |
| its Zod mirror | `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts` |
| a maintainer-ruled exact-shape pin | `data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts`, an **`Equal`** (not `extends`) assertion, whose comment says the shape is pinned deliberately |

Declared by maintainer ruling **#6882** (2026-08-30), replacing a `(schema as any)` cast, and `ObjectGrid.tsx` independently fences that package as *"published surface with its own review floor."*

⭐ The **`Equal`-not-`extends`** detail is what makes this airtight: an `extends` pin would tolerate an added member and B might have squeaked through as internal. It does not. B needs a seventh ctx member and therefore edits all three.

### What shipped, and what it is not

**A — `dependentValues: ctx.row`**, the saved record. A `dependsOn` lookup column is no longer **permanently uneditable**; the picker now scopes by the persisted parent ($filter reaches the query, and the control column over the same records still offers the row the filter excludes).

⛔ **A is not the answer to this card.** The staleness is real and now pinned as current behaviour: a parent edited but not yet saved in the same row does **not** re-scope the child. **B is filed as #7188** and this card stays open for it.

⚠️ One correction to my own dispatch: I called A "one line." The **declared** contract always carried `row`, but `ObjectGrid`'s **local** ctx annotation omitted it — so A was a two-part edit (widen the annotation, then pass it). A declared member that a local annotation silently narrows is a small hazard of its own: the type says the data is there, and the call site cannot see it.

### ⚖️ Ruling on the "should we tell the user" question I left live: **C**

I asked at dispatch that this not disappear into a code comment. It does not, and the answer is **C — close it by landing #7188, not by ruling that silence is acceptable.**

The deciding argument is one I did not have when I asked: ⭐ **a warning costs the *same seam change* as #7188 while delivering strictly less.** A hint reading *"scoped by the saved Region"* needs the staged record — exactly the ctx member #7188 adds. Having paid that price, you would ship a caption explaining the wrong scope instead of shipping the right scope. And a message would **fossilise the interim as a supported mode**: an author who declares `dependsOn` should get correct cascading, not a caption training them to accept a wrong scope.

⚠️ **The flip condition, adopted verbatim and binding:** if #7188 is declined, or deferred long enough that the interim stops being temporary, the silent staleness **must** be surfaced. The staleness is the same silent-wrongness class as the three refusals this seat landed this week (#7146 `no-positive-flow`, #7147 `no-positive-magnitude`, #7148 `unsized-rows`), and it is tolerable only because it is scheduled for deletion. ⇒ **This question is closed by #7188 landing, not by silence becoming the settled answer.**

### Incidence — carried, not closed

The dispatch forbade reporting this gap as "no impact", and it was measured with controls in both corpora:

- **this repo**: 3 files match `dependsOn|depends_on`, **none is this defect** (the gantt hit is `depends_on` as task predecessor links, a different key). Control: 88 files across `packages/`.
- **hotcrm**: **6 `dependsOn` declarations on lookup fields across 5 objects** (`crm_contract` ×2, `crm_case`, `crm_quote` ×2, `crm_opportunity`), all scoping contacts to `crm_account` — but **0 editable grids in its views**. Control: the views dir exists and was read.

⇒ ⭐ **Neither measured corpus reaches the defect today, but hotcrm is ONE metadata key away** — `editable: true` on any of those list views. That is the sentence that should drive #7188's priority. Customer apps remain unmeasured, and that is stated rather than glossed.

### Sibling filed

**#7190** — `plugin-detail`'s `InlineFieldInput` supplies no `dependentValues` either. ⛔ Deliberately **not** graded a bug: a detail page renders *one* record, so `ctx.data` may legitimately rescue the cascade there, and no rendering measurement was made. The single probe that settles it is written into that card.

Keeping this card open and `pm:dispatched` off; it returns to the queue for **#7188** once the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota reopens.

## ✅ Interim MERGED — PR #7193 is on `main` (`9c7490268`). ⛔ Card remains OPEN and `pm:blocked`.

Confirming the landing; the full ruling is already recorded in [comment 5492682950](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/7165#issuecomment-5492682950) and is not repeated.

Verified **by content with live controls**:

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| SUBJECT — `dependentValues` in `ObjectGrid.tsx` | **2** (the widened local annotation + the pass) |
| SUBJECT — the interim labelled in code, naming **#7188** | **3** |
| SUBJECT — new suite `gridDependentValues-7165.test.tsx` | **1** |
| CONTROL — `renderCellEditor` still live in the same file | **13** |
| ⭐ CONTROL — the **#7154 pin still exists** | **1** |

⭐ That last row is the one worth having. The #7154 pin **encoded the defect** — it asserted the gated trigger — so the fix necessarily turned it red. It was **updated in place, not deleted**, and its continued existence on `main` is what proves that. A deleted pin is indistinguishable from a pin that never existed, and deleting it would have been the easy way to make the suite green while erasing the only record that the gate was ever measured.

### State, unchanged and deliberate

- A `dependsOn` lookup column is **no longer permanently uneditable** — the picker scopes by the persisted parent.
- ⛔ The card does **not** close. **B is #7188**, blocked on the fable `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota; the interim's staleness (a parent edited but unsaved in the same row does not re-scope the child) is pinned as current behaviour, with its own proof the staging landed so the pin cannot pass vacuously.
- The "should we tell the user" question is ruled **C** — closed by #7188 landing, ⛔ **not** by silence becoming the settled answer. **The flip condition stands**: if #7188 is declined or deferred long enough that the interim stops being temporary, the staleness must be surfaced.

**Unblock-when:** the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota reopens, for #7188.
